title: Sliding Window Attention
hint: Like softmax attention but position i only attends to positions j where |i-j| <= window_size. Mask the rest with -inf.

description.text: Implement sliding-window (local) self-attention: each token attends only within a fixed window of width w along the sequence (Mistral-style), giving O(n·w) complexity instead of dense O(n²) attention.

constraints: Use PyTorch only unless task says otherwise.
